Hi, The Raspberry Pi is a great platform, but in my tests the Pi wasn't quite capable of smoothly running YouTube videos in a small window. I have wondered what recommendations there might be for the next step or two up in processing power in the same sort of form factor.
Recommendations for Something Better than Pi
I use an odroid C2. It is a decent step up for nearly the same price.
Thanks. I have wondered about that one. Will it run a normal Linux distro?

It has to be set up by someone that knows what they are doing, but yes. The default official Linux os is Ubuntu Mate. Runs pretty well. I am currently running DietPi which is a lightweight os based on a Debian build for it and it is lightning fast. Kodi starts up in maybe three or four seconds.

You'll want something with a hardware video decoder (at least H.264) or with enough power to decode in software. There is an option for buying a key to use the hardware decoder on the Pi's graphics chip but I don't know whether it is supported in any browsers (the interface FFmpeg uses for it is unusual).

My other suggestions would be an x86 PC that costs about 10x what the Pi does. Perhaps one of these "Intel NUC"s would be okay.
Thanks. I have looked at the NUC's. They do look interesting!

I Second the suggestion for a NUC. They will cost you more but are very powerful and compact. I replaced an old dual proc server with an i7 Nuc and its running my home vmware environment better than the dual quad xeon was.

You could try building a PC using the cheapest parts that are still relevant. Something a Celeron Process would be pretty cheap. Or, you could just keep fiddling with Pi. Trying to make it do things it shouldn't be able t do is part of the fun.
